title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown
hints: At the end of each day you are in one of three states: holding a share, just sold (so tomorrow is a cooldown), or free with no share. Draw the transitions between them.
hold = max(hold, rest - price); sold = hold + price; rest = max(rest, sold), each computed from yesterday's values. Start with hold = -prices[0], sold = -inf, rest = 0.
Only yesterday's three values are needed, so three variables and one pass. The answer is max(sold, rest) on the last day, never hold.
